Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Santa Barbara hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 8 of the 14 Santa Barbara hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, Booking.com at 1, the hotel's own site at 1 and trivago DEALS at 1. These are the Santa Barbara rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Santa Barbara hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 14% ($29 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 11% at Ala Mar Motel to 15% at Casa Del Mar Inn. At 2 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
